scenarios.name: v03_client_disconnected
scenarios.description: end(client_disconnected=true) adds client_disconnected: true; it is absent otherwise.

scenarios.name: v03_reserved_extra_properties
scenarios.description: Extra properties named source, surface, pause_reason, client_disconnected, attachment_count, attachment_types or trigger_event_id are dropped; other custom properties are kept.

scenarios.name: v03_task_mcp_event
scenarios.description: A task started by an MCP Events update carries trigger_source mcp_event and trigger_event_id.

scenarios.name: v03_cost_detail
scenarios.description: service_tier is normalised (default -> standard, priority -> fast, flex) and splits usage_breakdown entries; tier multipliers, long-context rates and server-tool fees are applied; cache_write_1h_tokens and server tool counts are reported per call and per entry; a server-tool kind without a fee leaves the fees out.

scenarios.name: v03_provider_service_tier_and_server_tools
scenarios.description: Provider-reported tiers and server tools: OpenAI Chat Completions service_tier priority is fast; Anthropic usage.service_tier standard with server_tool_use.web_search_requests is standard with server_tool_call_count, priced with server_tool_per_call; Anthropic priority (committed capacity) is other.

message.content: Mock answer.

scenarios.name: v03_track_score
scenarios.description: trackScore sends ai_interaction_scored with the score fields and context scoping; the explanation is sent only with content capture on, masked and capped at 280 characters; a score without a value or label, or with an unknown evaluator, is dropped.

scenarios.name: v03_evaluator
scenarios.description: A configured evaluator scores each successful answer after ai_response_received (one event per score, with the interaction's ids, scoping and trigger); a failed answer is not scored; without content capture the explanation is not sent.

scenarios.name: v03_evaluator_throws
scenarios.description: An evaluator that throws sends no score; the answer is unaffected.

scenarios.name: v03_classifier_escalated
scenarios.description: escalated is in the default outcome list.

scenarios.name: shutdown_ends_open_interaction
scenarios.description: shutdown() inside an open interaction ends it now: response_status incomplete with end_reason shutdown, the calls so far keep their usage, no error_type; the interaction's own end afterwards sends nothing more.

scenarios.name: v04_blocked_answers
scenarios.description: response_status blocked with block_reason (default other); error_type is never sent on a blocked answer; the app-set outcome may be unsupported (in the default outcomes).

scenarios.name: v04_confidence_and_handoff
scenarios.description: App-set confidence (low, medium, high; another value is not sent). A hand-off to a person is outcome escalated plus the hand-off tool's declared tool event.

scenarios.name: v04_credits_hook
scenarios.description: The credits hook prices each successful call beside USD: credits on the per-call event and usage_breakdown entries, total_credits on the answer when every successful call has credits. Credits set on record_call win; failed calls never ask the hook; an uncredited successful call leaves total_credits out.

scenarios.name: v04_credits_hook_throws
scenarios.description: A credits hook that raises leaves the call without credits; the answer is still sent.

scenarios.name: v04_limit_reached
scenarios.description: ai_limit_reached from track_limit_reached: limit_type plus the scope from the options or the enclosing context; interaction_id when the limit stopped one. Without limit_type it is dropped.

scenarios.name: v04_per_call_detail
scenarios.description: Per-call latency_ms and time_to_first_token_ms when the call was timed, app-set call_purpose, fallback_used and byok on ai_llm_response_received; usage_breakdown groups by call_purpose.

scenarios.name: v04_per_call_detail_wrapper_stream
scenarios.description: A streamed call through a wrapper created with call_purpose and byok: the integration times the call (latency_ms, time_to_first_token_ms) and every call through it carries the wrapper's fields.

scenarios.name: v04_versions
scenarios.description: agent_version and variant scope every event: from interaction or task options, the enclosing context, or track_action / track_score options.

scenarios.name: v04_mcp_client_tool_events
scenarios.description: Declared tool events of tool calls the app made as an MCP client carry mcp_server; result_size_bytes is the UTF-8 size of the result the SDK saw (a string as is, anything else as compact JSON); a denied call is tool_status denied.

scenarios.name: v04_compaction_and_context_limit
scenarios.description: compaction_count counts recorded compactions; a provider error for a request over the context window is error_type context_limit (OpenAI code context_length_exceeded, Anthropic prompt is too long).

scenarios.name: v04_pause_twice_in_process
scenarios.description: An interaction that pauses twice and resumes in the same process: each pause sends ai_response_received (paused, same interaction_id) with that segment's totals only; the final segment carries pause_count and total_paused_ms.

scenarios.name: v04_pause_implicit_resume
scenarios.description: A model call recorded while paused resumes the interaction; the pause reason defaults to other.

scenarios.name: v04_pause_noops_and_end_while_paused
scenarios.description: Pausing an interaction that is already paused sends nothing; end() while paused ends it (a cancelled final segment with no calls has no token totals); pause() after the end sends nothing.

scenarios.name: v04_interaction_resume_cross_process
scenarios.description: A paused interaction resumed from its saved snapshot (as another process would): identity and IDs come from the snapshot, no second prompt event, and the final segment counts the pause.

scenarios.name: v04_task_pauses_twice_across_processes
scenarios.description: A background task that pauses twice, each time resumed from its saved snapshot. ai_task_started (switched on) is sent once, when the run starts, never on a resume; the task's exit leaves a paused run open.

scenarios.name: v04_task_started_chained
scenarios.description: With emit_task_started on, a task chained inside an interaction sends ai_task_started first, with its parent and trigger_source agent; interactions send none.

scenarios.name: v04_end_paused_twice_in_process
scenarios.description: The existing end API with status paused closes only its segment; the interaction resumes twice and ends with segment totals and pause counters.

scenarios.name: v04_pause_dedup_in_process
scenarios.description: Since v0.4. Provider response IDs remain deduplicated through multiple pauses, including JSON snapshot handoff. New response IDs still count.

scenarios.name: v04_pause_dedup_json
scenarios.description: Since v0.4. Provider response IDs remain deduplicated through multiple pauses, including JSON snapshot handoff. New response IDs still count.

scenarios.name: v04_pause_buffered_json
scenarios.description: Since v0.4. Pause finalizes buffered adapter usage before handing off a JSON snapshot; the resumed empty segment adds no calls.

scenarios.name: v04_paused_end_disconnected
scenarios.description: Since v0.4. An explicit paused end applies client_disconnected before emitting its segment.

scenarios.name: v04_paused_end_buffer_reentry
scenarios.description: Since v0.4. An adapter finalizer reenters end during a paused end; exactly one paused segment counts its buffered usage.

scenarios.name: v04_bound_completion_after_pause
scenarios.description: Since v0.4. Normal bound stream completion leaves a paused interaction resumable. Go has no bound stream API.

scenarios.name: v04_shutdown_selection_then_pause
scenarios.description: Since v0.4. A pause after shutdown selects an interaction suppresses its stale finalization.
